> 第八章 一代剑圣（第1页）
夜色如墨，窗外淅淅沥沥地下起了冷雨。上官复头戴斗笠，身披蓑衣，独自穿过漆黑的街巷，来到了悦来茶馆门前。偌大的茶馆早已打烊，唯有侧边一扇不起眼的小门虚掩着，透出一丝幽暗的光。
上官复抬手轻叩门环，“笃、笃”两声，在寂静的雨夜里显得格外清晰。片刻后，门“吱呀”一声开了，一名小童探出头来。上官复压低声音问道：“玄机老先生可在？”
“在，先生请进。”小童侧身让开一条路。
上官复跨步而入，屋内光线昏暗，仅点着几盏如豆的油灯。角落里，一位老人正对着一方茶炉独坐，炉上的陶壶正咕嘟咕嘟煮着水，升腾起袅袅白雾。老人动作舒缓，正将茶叶缓缓拨入壶中。上官复走过去，在对面的木椅上坐下，蓑衣上的雨水顺着衣角滴落在地。
老人并未抬头，只是熟练地沏好一壶新茶，斟满两杯，推了一杯过去，苍老的声音响起：“上官帮主，多年不见，别来无恙。”
上官复端起茶杯抿了一口，借着昏黄的灯光打量对面。眼前的老人虽满脸风霜皱纹，那一双眼眸却深邃如寒星，隐隐透着摄人心魄的精光。上官复心头微微一紧，暗自警惕：“这老家伙的眼神还是这般犀利，仿佛能一眼看穿人心底最深处的算计。”
但他面上不动声色，拱手笑道：“托老先生的洪福，这几年江湖风平浪静，算是四平八稳。倒是老先生风采依旧，老而弥坚，令人佩服。”
玄机老人微微一笑，摇了摇头：“哪有什么风采，不过是快进黄土的枯骨罢了。上官帮主说笑了。老朽在此苦候多年，今日终于见到了那枚玉牌，也算是了却了一桩心愿。”
上官复目光灼灼地盯着老人，身体微微前倾，语气变得郑重：“不错，你我之间的三个约定，老先生已完成了两个。此前多亏您的指点，那两件事办得滴水不漏，尽如人意。如今只剩下最后一件——还请老先生出山，屈尊加入我长乐帮。我愿以帮中长老之礼相待，凡事铭听老先生教诲！”
玄机老人闻言，轻轻摆了摆手，神色淡然：“老朽疏懒成性惯了，上不了那么高的台面。只愿完成上官帮主这最后一件事后，能得个自由身，终老于山林泉石之间，不再过问江湖俗事。”
听到这话，上官复心中猛地一沉，一股难以言喻的失落与焦躁涌上心头。他死死盯着老人平静的面容，内心暗道：“我若得此老儿相助，便是如虎添翼，这江湖霸业何愁不成？可惜啊可惜，这么多年费尽心机，这老狐狸就是不肯就范，当真是一块捂不热的石头！”想到此处，他胸中郁结难舒，重重地叹了一口气，端起茶杯猛灌了一口，借此压下眼底的阴霾。
玄机老人仿佛对此视而不见，只是淡淡问道：“上官帮主今夜冒雨前来，究竟所为何事？不知老朽是否能够解答。”
上官复回过神来，深吸一口气，将长春真人与韩猛之事原原本本道出，末了沉声问道：“老先生行走江湖多年，可知道这青年究竟是谁？又是如何做到一剑便斩杀两位顶尖高手的？”
玄机老人听罢，原本捻须的手指突然僵在半空。他垂下眼帘，陷入了死一般的沉寂。屋内的空气仿佛在这一刻凝固了，只有炉火偶尔发出的噼啪声。
良久，老人的身形竟开始不受控制地微微颤抖起来。他猛地抬起头，额头上已渗出细密的冷汗，在那昏黄的灯光下显得触目惊心。他的瞳孔剧烈收缩，声音带着一丝从未有过的惊骇与颤栗：“莫非……是‘绝代一剑’？！难道这一剑，真的再现江湖了？！”

> Chapter 8 The Sword Master of the Generation (Page 1)
The night was dark, and cold rain was falling outside the window. Shangguan Fu, wearing a bamboo hat and a raincoat, walked alone through the dark streets and came to the door of Yuelai Tea House. The huge teahouse had long been closed, with only an inconspicuous small door on the side ajar, revealing a glimmer of dim light.
Shangguan Fu raised his hand and knocked lightly on the door knocker. The two sounds of "Du, Du" were particularly clear in the silent rainy night. After a moment, the door creaked open, and a child poked his head out. Shangguan Fu lowered his voice and asked, "Is Mr. Xuanji here?"
"Yes, sir, please come in." The child stepped aside to make way.
Shangguan Fu stepped in. The room was dimly lit, with only a few bean-like oil lamps lit. In the corner, an old man was sitting alone in front of a tea stove. The pottery pot on the stove was boiling water, and white mist was rising. The old man moved slowly and slowly poured the tea leaves into the pot. Shangguan Fu walked over and sat down on the wooden chair opposite. The rainwater on his coir raincoat dripped down to the ground.
The old man did not raise his head, but skillfully brewed a new pot of tea, filled two cups, and pushed one cup over. The old voice said: "Master Shangguan, I haven't seen you for many years. How are you?"
Shangguan Fu picked up the tea cup and took a sip, looking at the opposite side under the dim light. Although the old man's face was covered with weathered wrinkles, his eyes were as deep as cold stars, faintly revealing a soul-stirring light. Shangguan Fu's heart tightened slightly, and he was secretly vigilant: "This old guy's eyes are still so sharp, as if he can see through the deepest calculations in people's hearts at a glance."
But his face remained calm, he held up his hands and said with a smile: "Thanks to the great blessing of the old man, the world has been calm in the past few years, and everything is stable. But the old man still has the same style, and he is even stronger with age, which is admirable."
The old man Xuanji smiled slightly and shook his head: "There is no grace at all, they are just dead bones that are fast moving into the loess. The leader of the Shangguan clan was joking. The old man has been waiting here for many years, and today he finally saw the jade plaque, which can be regarded as fulfilling a wish."
Shangguan Fu stared at the old man with burning eyes, leaned forward slightly, and his tone became solemn: "Yes, the old man has completed two of the three agreements between you and me. Thanks to your guidance before, those two things were done flawlessly and as expected. Now there is only one last thing left - please come out of the old man and condescend to join our Changle Gang. I am willing to treat you as an elder in the gang, and I will always listen to the old man's teachings!"
Hearing this, Old Man Xuanji waved his hand gently, with an indifferent expression: "I have become accustomed to laziness and cannot reach such a high level. I only hope that after completing the last task of being the leader of the Shangguan Gang, I can be free and live my whole life among the mountains, forests, springs and rocks, and no longer interfere with the worldly affairs of the world."
Upon hearing this, Shangguan Fu's heart suddenly sank, and an indescribable feeling of loss and anxiety surged into his heart. He stared at the old man's calm face and thought to himself: "If I can get help from this old man, I will be even more powerful. Why should I worry about my dominance in the world? It's a pity, it's a pity that after so many years of hard work, this old fox just refuses to give in. He is really a stone that cannot be warmed!" Thinking of this, he felt heavy in his chest and sighed heavily. He picked up the tea cup and took a sip to suppress the haze in his eyes.
The old man Xuanji seemed to turn a blind eye to this, and just asked lightly: "Why did the leader of the Shangguan clan come here in the rain tonight? I wonder if I can answer it."
Shangguan came back to his senses, took a deep breath, and told the whole story about Changchun Master and Han Meng. Finally, he asked in a deep voice: "Old sir, you have been traveling around the world for many years. Do you know who this young man is? And how he managed to kill two top masters with one sword?"
After hearing this, the old man Xuanji's fingers that were twirling his beard suddenly froze in mid-air. He lowered his eyes and fell into a deathly state.Silence. The air in the room seemed to freeze at this moment, and there was only the occasional crackle of the fire.
After a long time, the old man's figure began to tremble uncontrollably. He raised his head suddenly, and a fine line of cold sweat broke out on his forehead, which looked shocking in the dim light. His pupils shrank violently, and his voice was filled with a hint of fear and trembling that he had never heard before: "Could it be... the 'peerless sword'?! Could it be that this sword has really reappeared in the world?!"
